name: order_swap_2d_puzzle
description: Swap one colored block with the empty grid cell per turn until the 2D grid matches the target arrangement.

difficulty_params.theoretical_min_steps: Exact shortest-path distance between the initial arrangement and the goal arrangement when any non-empty cell may swap with the blank cell.
difficulty_params.step_budget: Defaults to ceil(1.2 * theoretical_min_steps) unless overridden.

success_condition: The current grid exactly matches the goal grid before the step budget is exhausted.
